rules: Organisation names are grouped by relationship and remain curated evidence, not a complete logo wall.
The project summary uses Decision thesis; the later decision section supplies alternatives, trade-offs, and outcomes.
Mobile matcher controls become compact and sticky only while a result and the matcher section are active.
Mobile domain controls transition from the in-section rail to the floating rail without overlap.
Elevated rails reserve tokenised paint space and their section wrappers never clip shadows.
Comparable cards use a flex-column contract with their primary action aligned to the card baseline.
